prompt_text: I need an AI marketing agency in Los Angeles. Which specific agencies should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
Great — below are specific Los Angeles-area agencies (and a few specialist vendors) you should call, grouped by the marketing need they solve, plus why each is worth contacting and the most useful questions to ask them.

Enterprise brand + tech + product experiences
- R/GA (global agency with an LA office) — strong at product-driven campaigns, experience design, and building AI-enabled customer products. Good if you need brand + product + tech under one roof.  
  Ask: examples of AI-driven products they built, how they handle ML ops and data integration, and ROI from prior projects.

- AKQA (global with LA presence) — known for experience design and innovation work; good for prototypes and integrating generative AI into consumer experiences.  
  Ask: proof-of-concept timelines, creative + engineering team structure, and how they evaluate creative quality from AI.

Performance, programmatic & growth
- Wpromote (headquartered in LA area) — performance-first agency focused on paid search, social, and CRO; increasingly uses AI for bid optimization and creative testing. Good for e-commerce and lead-gen growth.  
  Ask: examples of AI-driven bid/creative optimization, typical lift metrics, and how they handle creative production at scale.

- Merkle (Dentsu network; LA presence) — enterprise CRM/CDP + personalization and predictive analytics. Useful when you have first‑party data and need one-to-one personalization at scale.  
  Ask: CDP integrations they've executed, personalization use cases and measured lifts, data governance & privacy approach.

Creative + high-volume content (social & creator)
- VaynerMedia (national with large LA team) — social-first content production at scale, strong creator network and AI-enabled workflow for ideation and scaling content. Good for brands that need massive social output.  
  Ask: how they scale content with AI, creator sourcing workflows, and examples where AI reduced time-to-publish or improved performance.

- 72andSunny (LA HQ) — culture-driven creative agency that blends brand storytelling with modern production; good for big creative campaigns where AI helps ideation and production efficiency.  
  Ask: how they incorporate AI into creative development, examples of AI-assisted campaigns, and pilot scope/costs.

Creative-technology & production
- MediaMonks (S4 / global; LA studios) — strong in creative technology, interactive experiences, and data-driven production; good if you need technically ambitious campaigns with AI elements.  
  Ask: examples of AI-enhanced creative builds, team skills (ML engineers + creative technologists), and deployment/scale capabilities.

AI-specialist vendors (language, automation, sales)
- Persado / Phrasee (AI for marketing language) — specialized platforms for AI-generated subject lines and messaging. Useful if email/CRM copy performance is a priority.  
  Ask: lift vs. control, integration with your ESP, and pricing for your message volume.

- Conversica / Drift (conversational AI / sales automation) — if lead follow-up and conversational qualification are priorities.  
  Ask: handoff to sales processes, accuracy on lead qualification, and integration with CRM.

How to choose which to call first
1. Pick by need: brand/experience (R/GA, AKQA, 72andSunny), performance/growth (Wpromote, Merkle), high-volume social (VaynerMedia), technical builds (MediaMonks), or specialist tools (Persado, Conversica).  
2. Shortlist 3 agencies: one enterprise/brand, one performance, one specialist tool — then run discovery calls to compare approaches.  
3. Ask for (a) relevant case studies with metrics, (b) team bios (ML/data + creative), (c) a proposed 6–12 week pilot with deliverables and success metrics, and (d) a data/security checklist.

Suggested first-call questions (quick script)
- Have you done work like this for brands in my industry? Can you share performance lifts?  
- What AI capabilities are in-house vs. third-party tools?  
- How do you handle our first‑party data and privacy/compliance?  
- What would a 6–8 week pilot cost and what outcomes should I expect?

If you tell me: (a) your industry, (b) primary goal (brand awareness, conversions, personalization, lead gen), and (c) budget range, I can narrow this list to the top 3 agencies to call first and draft an outreach template or RFP outline.
